evals.prompt: Review the diff of the branch that adds a new server action to revoke access

checks for a transactional owner re-check on the mutation
reproduces or marks each finding unverified with file:line

evals.prompt: Review this change that links accounts by matching e-mail automatically

checks the payload is validated at the adapter
checks the evidence for npm run check, test:db and test:browser
ends with Confidence and Escalate lines
